final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS c1, c.country AS c2, AVG(r.round) AS c3 FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), s2 AS (SELECT c.country AS d1, AVG(r.round) AS d2 FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT s1.c1, s1.c2, s1.c3, s1.c3 - s2.d2 AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON CAST(s1.c2 AS TEXT) = CAST(s2.d1 AS TEXT) ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
